problem-framing.code:
STATEMENTS = [
    "Users are frustrated with checkout so we should add a progress bar.",
    "First-time buyers abandon checkout when the address form rejects input; 61 tickets/month, step conversion 54% vs 81% desktop.",
    "Screen-reader users cannot recover when the coupon field errors silently; 9 of 12 test sessions failed at this step.",
    "Support agents want a redesign of the refunds screen.",
]

USER_WORDS = ["buyer", "agent", "admin", "engineer", "screen-reader user"]
SOLUTION_WORDS = ["modal", "progress bar", "redesign", "button", "dropdown", "wizard"]

def score_statement(s):
    low = s.lower()
    checks = [
        ("user", any(w in low for w in USER_WORDS)),
        ("trigger", "when " in low),
        ("sol_free", not any(w in low for w in SOLUTION_WORDS)),
        ("evidence", any(c.isdigit() for c in s)),
    ]
    flags = [name for name, ok in checks if not ok]
    return 4 - len(flags), flags

for i, s in enumerate(STATEMENTS, 1):
    score, flags = score_statement(s)
    verdict = "ACCEPT" if score == 4 else "REJECT"
    print(f"S{i}: {score}/4 [{', '.join(flags) if flags else 'clean'}] -> {verdict}")
print(f"accepted: {sum(1 for s in STATEMENTS if score_statement(s)[0] == 4)}/{len(STATEMENTS)}")

user-journey-mapping.code:
STEPS = [
    ("browse", 10000, 6200),
    ("cart", 6200, 5400),
    ("address", 5400, 2916),
    ("payment", 2916, 2624),
    ("confirm", 2624, 2597),
]
ERRORS = {"address": (1980, 396)}

def step_rate(entered, completed):
    return completed / entered * 100

def cumulative(steps):
    base = steps[0][1]
    return [completed / base * 100 for _, _, completed in steps]

def worst_step(steps):
    return min(steps, key=lambda s: step_rate(s[1], s[2]))[0]

cums = cumulative(STEPS)
for (name, entered, completed), cum in zip(STEPS, cums):
    print(f"{name}: rate={step_rate(entered, completed):.1f}% cum={cum:.1f}%")

worst = worst_step(STEPS)
print(f"worst: {worst}")
with_err, recovered = ERRORS[worst]
entered = next(s[1] for s in STEPS if s[0] == worst)
completed = next(s[2] for s in STEPS if s[0] == worst)
print(f"error-recovery: {recovered}/{with_err} = {recovered / with_err * 100:.1f}%")
print(f"error-free pass-rate: {(completed - recovered) / (entered - with_err) * 100:.1f}%")

design-tokens.code:
TOKENS = {
    "red.600": "#dc2626",
    "gray.400": "#9ca3af",
    "blue.500": "#3b82f6",
    "color.text.error": "red.600",
    "color.border.error": "red.600",
    "color.text.disabled": "gray.400",
    "color.text.link": "blue.500",
    "color.text.warning": "amber.500",
    "color.brand.legacy": "color.brand.old",
    "color.brand.old": "color.brand.legacy",
}

STYLES = [
    (".coupon-error", "#dc2626"),
    (".sidebar-link", "#3b82f6"),
    (".promo-badge", "#7c3aed"),
]

def resolve(name, tokens):
    seen = set()
    cur = name
    while True:
        if cur in seen:
            return "CYCLE"
        seen.add(cur)
        if cur not in tokens:
            return "MISSING"
        val = tokens[cur]
        if val.startswith("#"):
            return val
        cur = val

def orphans(styles, tokens):
    sem = sorted(n for n in tokens if n.startswith("color."))
    out = []
    for selector, value in styles:
        match = next((n for n in sem if resolve(n, tokens) == value), None)
        out.append((selector, value, match or "no-token-matches"))
    return out

sem_tokens = sorted(n for n in TOKENS if n.startswith("color."))
for n in sem_tokens:
    print(f"{n} -> {resolve(n, TOKENS)}")
for selector, value, suggestion in orphans(STYLES, TOKENS):
    print(f"orphan: {selector} {value} use {suggestion}")

prototype-to-code-handoff.code:
SPEC = {
    "button.height": "48px",
    "button.bg": "#2563eb",
    "field.gap": "16px",
    "error.color": "#b91c1c",
    "label.font-size": "14px",
    "focus.ring": "2px #2563eb",
    "disabled.opacity": "0.5",
    "motion.expand": "200ms",
}
BUILD = {
    "button.height": "48px",
    "button.bg": "#2563EB",
    "field.gap": "12px",
    "error.color": "#ef4444",
    "label.font-size": "14px",
    "disabled.opacity": "0.5",
    "motion.expand": "180ms",
}
POLICIES = {
    "button.height": "exact",
    "button.bg": "exact-color",
    "field.gap": "exact",
    "error.color": "exact-color",
    "label.font-size": "exact",
    "focus.ring": "exact",
    "disabled.opacity": "exact",
    "motion.expand": "band-20",
}

def audit(spec, build, policies):
    out = []
    for prop, spec_val in spec.items():
        if prop not in build:
            out.append((prop, "MISSING"))
            continue
        build_val = build[prop]
        policy = policies[prop]
        if policy == "exact-color":
            ok = spec_val.lower() == build_val.lower()
        elif policy == "band-20":
            s = float(spec_val.rstrip("ms"))
            b = float(build_val.rstrip("ms"))
            ok = abs(b - s) / s <= 0.20
        else:
            ok = spec_val == build_val
        out.append((prop, "OK" if ok else "MISMATCH"))
    return out

results = audit(SPEC, BUILD, POLICIES)
for prop, verdict in results:
    print(f"{prop}: {verdict}")
counts = {v: sum(1 for _, x in results if x == v) for v in ("OK", "MISMATCH", "MISSING")}
print(f"ok={counts['OK']} mismatch={counts['MISMATCH']} missing={counts['MISSING']}")
print(f"handoff-complete: {'yes' if counts['MISMATCH'] == 0 and counts['MISSING'] == 0 else 'no'}")

design-review-packet.code:
VERIFY_REQUIRED = {"state-inventory", "a11y-contract", "instrumentation"}
TIER_RANK = {"design": 0, "build": 1, "runtime": 2}

SECTIONS = [
    ("frame-and-non-goals", 15, 2, 2,
        ["problem-statement.md (4/4 linter)", "non-goal-ledger.md (spec)"]),
    ("state-inventory", 25, 20, 20,
        ["states_grid.fig (20 cells, mockups)", "note: engineering has the file"]),
    ("a11y-contract", 25, 19, 25,
        ["contrast_table.xlsx computed from Figma hexes", "keyboard_trace.md: will follow the standard pattern"]),
    ("critique-history", 15, 7, 7,
        ["decision-log.md (7 entries, spec)"]),
    ("instrumentation", 20, 6, 6,
        ["event-schema validated on staging", "coverage: lab check output, 6/6"]),
]

def classify_evidence(row):
    r = row.lower()
    if any(k in r for k in [".fig", "mockup", "spec", "figma", "will ", "has the file"]):
        return "design"
    if any(k in r for k in ["staging screenshot", "dom-computed", "handoff-audit", "recorded"]):
        return "build"
    if any(k in r for k in ["validated", "staging event", "lab check"]):
        return "runtime"
    return "design"

def section_tier(rows):
    return min((classify_evidence(r) for r in rows), key=lambda t: TIER_RANK[t])

def gate(sections):
    naive = 0.0
    gated = 0.0
    scored = []
    for name, weight, done, total, rows in sections:
        base = weight * done / total
        tier = section_tier(rows)
        naive += base
        g = 0.0 if (name in VERIFY_REQUIRED and tier == "design") else base
        gated += g
        scored.append((name, tier, g, weight))
    verdict = "SHIP" if gated >= 90 else "HOLD"
    return scored, naive, gated, verdict

scored, naive, gated, verdict = gate(SECTIONS)
for name, tier, g, weight in scored:
    print(f"{name}: {tier} -> {g:.1f}/{weight}")
print(f"naive-score: {naive:.1f}")
print(f"gated-score: {gated:.1f}")
print(f"verdict: {verdict}")
